labels.title: The Value Proposition Canvas
labels.valueProposition: Inventory Management – Mobile Warehouse & Barcode Automation
labels.customerSegment: Warehouse Operators, Floor Managers & Second-Hand Retail Logistics Teams

customerJobs.title: Core Workflow 1
customerJobs.note: Unreliable Barcode Scanning in Warehouse Conditions

pains.title: Desktop-Tethered Registration Bottlenecks
pains.note: Floor operators had to haul garments to desktop PCs or hand-write paper intake sheets, causing massive intake delays during container arrivals.

pains.title: Undetected Misplaced Stock & Phantom Out-of-Stocks
pains.note: Garments placed on incorrect shelf/box bins went unnoticed for weeks, showing as unavailable for sale while physically in the warehouse.

pains.title: Slow Single-Item Scanning & Form Navigation Fatigue
pains.note: Scanning barcode labels one-by-one with mandatory screen confirmation caused high operator fatigue and slow intake rates.

pains.title: Language Barrier for Warehouse Floor Staff
pains.note: Complex English ERP interfaces caused operator misclassification and required extensive supervision.

gains.title: On-Floor Mobile Registration with Photo Upload
gains.note: Capacitor 8 Android app captures product photos directly via Capacitor Camera, uploads to Cloudinary CDN, and registers inventory in sub-seconds.

gains.title: Structured 3-State Shelf & Bin Audit Mode
gains.note: Operators scan boxes to verify expected stock, immediately detect misplaced items via live DB queries, and relocate them with one-tap atomic RPCs.

gains.title: Google ML Kit Continuous Batch Queue Scanning
gains.note: Hardware-accelerated continuous camera decoding with audio/haptic feedback queues dozens of scans for instant bulk location/status updates.

gains.title: Bilingual Operator Interface (English + Bengali)
gains.note: Complete high-contrast bilingual localization (বাংলা + EN) with persisted device locale and large touch targets designed for warehouse floors.
